name: Love on the Battlefield
oracle_text: Whenever you attack with exactly two creatures, those creatures gain first strike until end of turn, then draw a card. Whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage to a player this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
blocked_sentences: Whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage to a player this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

needs.what: a `this_combat` duration for the event-watching `delayed_trigger` op: a subscription created by a resolving attack trigger, scoped to the attacking creatures (the `attackers` binding, as `trigger.subject`), firing on each `deals_combat_damage_to_player` by one of them and putting a +1/+1 counter on that dealer (the event's `subject` binding), and struck off when the current combat phase ends rather than at cleanup
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `delayed_trigger` accepts only the durations in DELAYED_DURATIONS (this_turn, until_it_fires, once_this_turn, until_your_next_turn). `this_turn` (Tamiyo, Field Researcher's shape) would keep firing in an extra combat later in the turn, where the printed card gives no counter; `once_this_turn`/`until_it_fires` would stop after the first of the two creatures connects. `this_combat` exists only as an AttackRestriction duration. The packet's `trigger_keys` also do not list `subject`, so the scoping to "either of those creatures" is not in the advertised vocabulary either. The first sentence (you_attack with count of attackers == 2, grant_keyword first_strike on the attackers binding, draw) is expressible on its own.
